page.overview:
Who is Beena?

Beena was a young female Twi'lek whom Lando Calrissian entertained in Cloud City, along with an entire diplomatic brigade of young Twi'leks. She was berated by the Twi'lek guardian Kaasha Bateen for asking Calrissian a question about why Cloud City was in the clouds, despite it having been taught about it already in class.
